definitions.explanation: A singer, comedian, or other performer who had one big hit and was never as successful again. Used humorously or a little unkindly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一発屋|いっぱつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わった。
examples.english: He ended up a one-hit wonder.

examples.japanese: {一発屋|いっぱつや}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれたくない→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to be called a one-hit wonder.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一発屋|いっぱつや}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}われていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: People thought that comedian was a one-hit wonder, but he is still going strong.

notes:
From ⟦{一発|いっぱつ}→一発：08895_ippatsu⟧ (one shot) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (a person who does something). Most often said of pop singers and TV comedians whose one catchphrase or song swept the country for a year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一発屋|いっぱつや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わる: to end up a one-hit wonder
- {一発屋|いっぱつや}⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧: a comedian known for one gag
- {一発屋|いっぱつや}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called a one-hit wonder

REGISTER:
Casual and slightly mocking; comedians sometimes use it about themselves as a joke.
